decisions.reason: Names PID 42432 web host as holder; image-section lock released only on process exit causes npm's copyfile EBUSY.
Refresh reloads only the SPA; ordered stop-verify-install-restart procedure targets the dsh host and workers specifically.
Bare name resolves via latest=0.1.1-rc.2, not the newest or installed version; alpha.5 lives only on alpha, so the install silently downgrades.
One pinned combined install (dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 + TUI exact version) after full host stop, with dsh --version verification and restart.
Demands exact pins instead of dist-tags, split or fully-pinned combined commands, and stop-host plus verification steps in READMEs.
